mapper.select: SELECT cloth_code, listagg(M.MACHINE_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY M.MACHINE_ID) MACHINE_ID FROM T_CD90_SPECIFY_MACHINE M LEFT JOIN T_CD90_MACHINE_INFO MI ON MI.ID = M.MACHINE_ID WHERE M.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MI.STATUS = '0' AND M.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} GROUP BY cloth_code
